Ultimate ASI Loader 9.7.4 - Witcher 3 Remastered DX12 - WINMM

DLL VARIANT INCLUDED: winmm.dll (x64)
INSTALL LOCATION: bin/x64_dx12/winmm.dll
Need another DLL variant? Leave a comment naming the DLL you need; I will
provide an alternative package after checking compatibility. Do not install
multiple variants together. Other variants are not verified by this test.

Author of Ultimate ASI Loader: ThirteenAG and contributors.
Original project: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader
Official release: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/tag/v9.7.4
License: MIT. Full upstream license is included.

INSTALLATION
Install this ZIP with Vortex for The Witcher 3 and deploy.
The ONLY executable file added is bin/x64_dx12/winmm.dll.
This is the unmodified official x64 loader, renamed to a supported proxy name.
No dinput8.dll or original game configuration file is included or replaced.
Do not install if you already have a winmm.dll mod in this directory.

ASI plugins belong in bin/x64_dx12/plugins or bin/x64_dx12/scripts.
This package contains NO Freecam ASI plugin and adds no gameplay features alone.
The existing Freecam dinput8.dll is not converted by installing this loader.
Use only one ASI loader where possible; do not install multiple variants together.

VERIFICATION AND TEST STATUS
The local Remastered DX12 witcher3.exe directly imports WINMM.dll.
Upstream documents winmm.dll as a supported x64 proxy name.
Archive layout and binary architecture are checked. The uploader confirmed
successful in-game operation with our separate Freecam ASI on Remastered 5.0
DX12. This does not guarantee compatibility with every other ASI plugin.
DX11 and other game installations are not covered by this verification.

UNINSTALLATION
Disable/remove this package in Vortex and deploy again.
It should remove only the winmm.dll owned by this package, not dinput8.dll.
Never delete other mods' DLLs or the game's original files as part of installation.
